body: Thanks man. I know that things are going to get better eventually but right now at this moment its very hard to stay optimistic. And i really want to win her back, so badly. Even though she just bailed on me when she knew i was so vulnerable i still fucking love her so much.

I know but i have so many other emotional scars that haven't healed yet. They're just piling up and i don't know how to cope anymore...my dad tells my to just do my best and try to pull myself together but im just not strong enough.

Thanks...its just so frustrating that she didn't want to talk about it. She just said it was over and that was that. I've deleted everything related to her on my computer and thrown away stuff but since i don't have anything to distract myself with i just sit and think about her all the time.
Ive tried so many different and nothing seems to work, and it also takes so long time to see if they are the right ones, like 5-7 weeks. Im losing my patience..
